title: CMA Awards 2026 with Taylor Swift & More Live on SiriusXM
summary: Hear exclusive interviews leading up to a simulcast of The 60th CMA Awards on CMA Awards Radio on The Highway.
body_markdown:
Country Music’s Biggest Night is taking over SiriusXM’s[The Highway (Ch. 56)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-highway) !


From Monday, November 16 through Wednesday, November 18, The Highway becomes **CMA Awards Radio** , your all-access pass to “The 60th Annual CMA Awards” live from Bridgestone Arena in Nashville.


[CMA Awards Radio The Highway (Ch. 56) • November 16–18 Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCMAAwardsRadioTheHighway)


## CMA Awards Radio on SiriusXM


### How to Listen


Tune in to CMA Awards Radio on The Highway (Ch. 56) on satellite radio and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCMAAwardsRadioTheHighway) from November 16–18.


### CMA Awards Radio Broadcast Schedule


**Monday, November 16–Wednesday, November 18:** Hear exclusive interviews with CMA Awards nominees, performers, and presenters leading up to the big night.


**Wednesday, November 18 at 6pm ET:** Tune in for the live CMA Awards red carpet pre-show.


**Wednesday, November 18 at 8pm ET:** Hear an exclusive, ad-free audio simulcast of “The 60th CMA Awards,” live from Bridgestone Arena in Nashville.


### CMA Awards Performers


The 60th CMA Awards will feature performances by some of country music’s biggest names, including Taylor Swift, who returns to the CMA Awards stage for her first performance in 13 years.


Other announced performers include Cody Johnson, Ella Langley, Kacey Musgraves, Lainey Wilson, Luke Combs, Megan Moroney, Miranda Lambert, The Red Clay Strays, Tim McGraw, Tucker Wetmore, Vince Gill, and Zach Top.


Special collaborations will feature Mumford & Sons with Chris Stapleton, and Stephen Wilson Jr. with Chris Stapleton.


The show will also include a special tribute to country music icon Dolly Parton, celebrating her extraordinary influence and legacy. Additionally, Brothers Osborne, HARDY, Luke Bryan, Marcus King, and Halestorm will come together to honor Brooks & Dunn, the recipients of this year’s CMA Willie Nelson Lifetime Achievement Award.


### Watch The 60th CMA Awards Awards on ABC and Disney+


**Live November 18 at 8/7c on ABC and Disney+ (next day on Hulu).**


For more information about The 60th CMA Awards, visit[CMAawards.com](https://cmaawards.com/) .
